svg.title: Prim's algorithm — animated step-by-step
svg.desc: Animated SVG that loops through the six steps of Prim's algorithm on a six-vertex graph. Each frame shows two panels side by side: the hexagonal graph view on the left (vertices coloured green for S, red for V\S; edges blue for A, orange for crossing, faint grey for internal; the just-added edge wears an orange halo), and the partition re-view on the right (S ellipse and V\S ellipse with vertices distributed accordingly). The animation loops indefinitely.

g.text: Step 0. Three edges cross the cut: 1–2 (1), 1–6 (6), 1–4 (8). Lightest: 1–2 — about to enter A.
Step 1. Vertex 2 hopped into S. Crossings: 1–6 (6), 1–4 (8), 2–6 (2), 2–3 (7). Lightest next: 2–6.
Step 2. Vertex 6 hopped into S. Crossings: 1–4 (8), 2–3 (7), 5–6 (3). Lightest next: 5–6.
Step 3. Vertex 5 hopped into S. Crossings: 1–4 (8), 2–3 (7), 3–5 (9), 4–5 (4). Lightest next: 4–5.
Step 4. Vertex 4 hopped into S. Crossings: 2–3 (7), 3–4 (5), 3–5 (9). Lightest next: 3–4.
Graph G — S = V, A is the MST
Step 5. |A| = n − 1 = 5, w(A) = 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 5 = 15. V \ S is empty; A spans V. A is the MST.
